name: HW/SW Codesign
description: The module covers the design flow from a system specification in form of function graphs down to FPGA netlists and executable object code for microprocessors with special focus on the partitioning of sub-functions into a software and a hardware part of a System-on-Chip (SoC). The major topics are: modeling and specification of mixed hardware/software solutions for embedded systems, graph partitioning and binding to execution units, scheduling of tasks, estimation of design quality.
